description: Build modelled suggested runs in time order from forecast weather, sun, snow and mapped terrain. Only plans days inside the reported winter season; summer lift or bike-park operation does not count as open for skiing. Easy, intermediate and advanced exclude expert, freeride and extreme terrain; only expert permits it. Suggestions are not a connected route or live piste status. mode "sun" (Chase the sun): a day's line through lifts and runs that stays in the light, with clock times (clear sky assumed; easy and intermediate keep off black runs).

resort.description: Resort name such as 'Zermatt', or numeric resort id such as 675 (from search_resorts)
